crossRefs.note: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

crossRefs.note: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs…

crossRefs.note: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful…
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and…
crossRefs.keyword: Fret.or, Keep not company with the wicked

crossRefs.note: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;
Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.
Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
